DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の申込みですね。まず、お話しになりたい内容をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to apply for a consultation. First, tell me what you want to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越したあとに通知が二通届きました。同じ手続きを二回するのか分からず、相談の予約をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二通の通知が同じ手続きか分からず相談予約を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two notices arrived after I moved. I don't know whether I need to do the same procedure twice, so I'd like to book a consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want a consultation booking because you do not know whether two notices concern the same procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二通の宛名と差出窓口を見てみましょう。こちらはあなた宛てですが、もう一通は別のお名前ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's look at the addressees and sending counters. This one is for you, but the other has a different name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本当ですね。封を開けていないほうは前に住んでいた人かもしれません。自分の通知とは分けて相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別名義の未開封通知を自分の通知と分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: You're right. The unopened one may be for the previous resident. Can I discuss it separately from my own notice?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Discuss the unopened notice in another name separately from your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。別のお名前の通知は宛名が違う件として扱い、あなた宛ての通知は内容の相談先を調べます。説明の際に希望する言語はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. We'll treat the different-name notice as an incorrect addressee issue, and find the consultation contact for your own notice. Do you have a preferred language for explanations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベトナム語の支援を希望します。用語を間違えて覚えないよう、分からない言葉もメモにしてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベトナム語支援の希望と不明用語のメモを用意したことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like Vietnamese support. I also brought notes of unfamiliar words so I don't learn the terms incorrectly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your preference for Vietnamese support and that you prepared notes of unfamiliar terms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その希望を申込みに添えます。支援の手配と予約日時は、担当からの確認を経て決まるので、今はまだ確定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll add that to the application. Support arrangements and the appointment date require confirmation by the responsible staff, so neither is confirmed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、勤務の都合がつく日時を二つ書きます。この用紙に書くのは予約の申込みで、確定した日時ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希望日時を二つ記入し、申込みと予約確定の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll write two times that fit my work schedule. Writing on this form is an appointment application, not a confirmed time, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write two preferred times and check the distinction between applying and a confirmed appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのとおりです。二通を分けた相談内容、希望言語、ご都合と連絡先を受け付けました。折り返しの内容を確認してから予定を決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's right. We've received the two separate issues, language preference, availability and contact details. Check the callback before deciding your plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先に間違いがないか読み直しました。自分宛ての通知と質問のメモを保管して、日時が決まる連絡を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を読み直し、自分の通知と質問を保管して確定連絡を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've reread the contact details for mistakes. I'll keep my own notice and question notes and wait for the call confirming the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you reread the contact details, will keep your notice and questions, and await confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お申込みはお預かりしました。通知の宛名が違う件も担当へ伝えます。本日はこれで結構です。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've received your application. We'll tell the staff about the incorrect addressee too. That's all for today. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りになる前に、受診後のことで聞いておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you leave, is there anything you want to ask about after your visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社へ受診したことを知らせる紙が必要です。この領収書と、診断書というものは同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受診証明を求められた事情を伝え、領収書と診断書が同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need a paper to tell my company I attended a medical visit. Are this receipt and a medical certificate the same?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you were asked for proof of attendance and ask whether a receipt and medical certificate are the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ書類ではありません。どの書類で足りるかは提出先の求める内容によります。会社から、何を記載するよう言われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: They are different documents. Which is enough depends on what the recipient requires. What information did your company request?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「受診した日が分かるもの」とだけ聞きました。病名まで必要かは言われていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社が求めたのは受診日で、病名の要否は不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They only said something showing the date of the visit. They haven't said whether the illness name is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the company requested the visit date and the need for a diagnosis name is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、受診日の確認だけなのか、医師の記載も求めているのかを会社に尋ねると整理できます。領収書でよいかは、会社での確認になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ask the company whether they only need the visit date or also a doctor's statement. The company must confirm whether a receipt is acceptable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社には、領収書の写しで足りるかと、原本が必要かも聞きます。今ここで診断書を申し込まなくても、相談を続けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写しか原本かを会社に尋ね、診断書申込みを保留して相談できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask whether a copy of the receipt is enough or the original is required. Can I continue consulting without applying for a medical certificate right now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the company about copy versus original and ask whether consultation can continue with the certificate application deferred. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な内容が分かってから書類窓口へ相談する方法があります。発行の可否や手続き、費用、受取時期は、その窓口で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can consult the document counter after learning the required information. Ask that counter about availability, procedures, fees and collection timing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 費用や受取日は書類窓口で聞きます。先に会社の必要項目を確かめてから、その窓口へ行けばよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類種類・費用・受取時期は書類窓口への相談事項と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask the document counter about costs and collection dates. So I should first check the company's required items and then go there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that document type, fees and collection timing are matters for the document counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。会社への質問をこのメモに整理して、領収書とは別にしておきましょう。今日は申込みをした状態にはなっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Organize your questions for the company on this note and keep it separate from the receipt. You have not submitted an application today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 質問のメモができたので、領収書の原本はなくさないようにしまいます。会社の返答を聞いてから書類窓口に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 質問メモと領収書原本を保管し、会社の返答後に書類窓口へ相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've made the question note, so I'll store the original receipt safely. After hearing my company's reply, I'll consult the document counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the question note and original receipt and consult the document counter after the company's reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それで今回のご相談は終わりです。メモと領収書をお忘れなく。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: That completes today's consultation. Don't forget the note and receipt. Please take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくされた物のご相談ですか。分かる範囲からお聞きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about something lost? I'll start with what you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 青い布の財布が見当たりません。買い物から帰って、かばんを開けたときに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 青い布財布が帰宅後に見当たらなくなった事情を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My blue fabric wallet is missing. I noticed when I opened my bag after returning from shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your blue fabric wallet was missing after you returned home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に財布を手にしたのは、いつ、どこだったか覚えていますか。なくした場所が分からなくても、そのまま教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember when and where you last held it? Even if you don't know where you lost it, tell us exactly that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店で会計したのは午後二時だと思っていましたが、別にしまったレシートには一時二十分とあります。レジで使ったのが最後です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記憶の二時とレシートの一時二十分を区別し、最後に使った場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I paid at the store at two, but the receipt I kept separately says one twenty. Using it at checkout was the last time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the remembered two o'clock from the receipt's one twenty and explain the last place you used it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 時刻はレシートの記載として残し、その後どこでなくしたかは未確定としましょう。ほかの財布と見分ける特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll record the time as written on the receipt, leaving where you lost it afterward unconfirmed. Are there distinguishing features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 内側に小さな白い布を縫い付けてあります。外の青い色だけではなく、その部分も特徴に書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内側に縫った白い布という識別特徴を届け出に加える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: A small white cloth is sewn inside. Please record that, not only the blue outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add the identifying white cloth sewn inside to the report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内側の白い布ですね。店を出たあとの経路も伺いますが、覚えている場所と推測は分けて構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The white cloth inside, understood. We'll also ask your route afterward; you can separate remembered places from guesses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 店の前でかばんを持ち直したことは覚えています。でも、そのとき財布を見たわけではないので、落とした場所とは断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: かばんを持ち直した記憶と財布を落とした場所の推測を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I remember adjusting my bag outside the store. But I didn't see the wallet then, so I can't say that was where I dropped it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish remembering adjusting the bag from guessing where the wallet fell. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その区別を含めて届け出内容を整理しました。連絡先はこの欄でよろしいですか。届出をしたことと、品物が見つかったことは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've organized the report with that distinction. Are these contact details correct? Filing a report and finding the item are separate things.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この連絡先で大丈夫です。今はまだ見つかったわけではないと理解しました。店にも、落とし物が届いていないか問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を確かめ、未発見の状態で店にも問い合わせると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Those details are fine. I understand it hasn't been found yet. I'll also ask the store whether anyone handed it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the contact details and decide to inquire at the store while the wallet remains unfound. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容の確認は以上です。お手元の控えは保管してください。それでは、道中も持ち物にお気をつけて。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: That finishes checking the details. Keep your copy. Mind your belongings on the way too. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの用紙は不在票ですね。どのようにお受け取りになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The paper you brought is a missed-delivery notice. How would you like to receive the parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事帰りに受け取ろうと思って来ました。この窓口で荷物を出してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事帰りの受取を希望し、この窓口で荷物を受け取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came to collect it after work. Can I have the parcel handed over at this counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request collection after work and ask whether this counter can hand over the parcel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 票の保管先欄には、こちらとは別の窓口名が書かれています。今ここに荷物があるとは確認できません。宛名はご本人ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The storage section names a different counter. We cannot confirm the parcel is here now. Are you the addressee?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宛名は私です。窓口ならどこでも受け取れると思っていました。移動する前に、票の照会先へ聞いたほうがいいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分宛てと伝え、どの窓口でも受け取れるという思い込みを訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought any counter could hand it over. I should contact the notice's inquiry number before traveling, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is addressed to you and correct the assumption that any counter can provide it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。荷物の種類や保管状況を確認できる相手へ、票の番号を伝えてください。保管期限の欄も読み落とさないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Give the notice number to the party who can check its type and storage status. Don't overlook the storage deadline either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 期限の欄はここですね。受け取れる窓口と日時を聞いて、仕事のあとに間に合うか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 票の期限欄を確かめ、保管先へ受取場所と日時を照会すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the deadline section. I'll ask the collection counter and times, and check whether I can make it after work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the notice's deadline and inquire at the storage location about collection place and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身で行く方法だけでなく、再配達を希望するなら、その票で受け付ける方法も一緒に尋ねられます。まだどちらも手配は済んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Besides collecting yourself, if you want redelivery, you can ask how that notice accepts requests too. Neither arrangement is complete yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族が行けると言っているので、代理での受け取りが可能かと、その場合の持ち物も聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族の代理受取が可能かと必要な持ち物を聞く意向を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family says they can go, so I'll also ask whether collection by a representative is possible and what to bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you will ask whether family may collect on your behalf and the required items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 代理受取の条件も、荷物を確認できる窓口から案内を受けてください。こちらで受取先の変更や再配達を受け付けた状態ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Get representative-collection conditions from the counter that can check the parcel. We haven't accepted a change of collection place or redelivery here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで予約したわけではないので、まず票の照会先に連絡します。家族には、条件が分かるまでは取りに行かないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手配は未了と確認し、照会まで家族の移動を待ってもらうと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Nothing was booked here, so I'll contact the inquiry point first. I'll tell my family not to go until the conditions are known.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm arrangements are unfinished and decide to ask family to wait until the inquiry is complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お聞きになる内容がまとまりましたね。不在票をお返ししますので、お忘れなくお持ちください。よい一日をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your questions are organized. I'll return the notice; remember to take it. Have a good day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの件でお急ぎでしょうか。まず、ご用件をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your card query urgent? First tell me what you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: キャッシュカードをなくしたので、使えないようにしたいです。いつも通る場所だったので、こちらへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紛失したキャッシュカードの利用停止を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've lost my cash card and want to stop its use. I came here because it's on my usual route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to consult about blocking your lost cash card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発行した金融機関はお分かりですか。こちらの銀行のカードかどうかを先に確かめましょう。暗証番号はお話しにならないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the issuing institution? Let's first check whether it's this bank's card. Don't tell us your PIN.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通帳の表紙を見たら、こちらとは違う銀行の名前でした。近い窓口なら停止できると勘違いしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通帳で別銀行の発行と分かり、窓口を取り違えたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bankbook cover shows a different bank. I wrongly thought a nearby counter could block it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the bankbook shows another bank issued it and you came to the wrong counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発行元の手続き先に相談する必要があります。この窓口で停止が完了したわけではありません。発行元を確かめられる資料はお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need the issuer's procedural contact. Blocking has not been completed here. You have documents identifying the issuer, right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通帳と口座を作ったときの書類があります。紙にある連絡先が発行元の案内か、自分で照合してから電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通帳と口座開設書類を使い、発行元の公式連絡先を照合すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the bankbook and account-opening documents. I'll compare the contact on the paper with the issuer's information myself before calling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the bankbook and opening documents to verify the issuer's official contact details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。発行元の公式な案内で相談先を確かめてください。ここで伺った内容だけでは、そちらのカードの利用状況も分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, check the consultation point in the issuer's official guidance. What you've told us here doesn't reveal the other card's usage status either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最近の利用に見覚えがないものがないかも、発行元へ相談します。停止の申出と取引の確認は、別々に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用停止の申出と身に覚えのない取引の確認を別に相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll also ask the issuer whether there are recent transactions I don't recognize. I'll separately explain the blocking request and transaction inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will discuss blocking and unrecognized transactions separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紛失の相談、停止の受付状況、取引の確認を分けて聞けますね。後で見つかった場合の扱いも、発行元の案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can separate the loss report, blocking status and transaction checks. Ask the issuer what to do if you later find the card too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ停止済みではないので、このあと発行元に連絡します。見つかっても自分でそのまま使わず、案内された対応を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止未了と理解し、発行元への連絡と後日発見時の対応確認を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: It isn't blocked yet, so I'll contact the issuer next. If I find it, I won't just use it; I'll check the instructed response.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge blocking is unfinished and decide to contact the issuer and check action if found later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 相談先は整理できました。通帳と書類をお返ししますので、お確かめください。本日はこれで失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The right contact is clear. I'll return your bankbook and documents; check them. That is all from us today. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品のご相談はこちらで伺います。袋は置いたままで結構です。どのような状態でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: We hear product queries here. You can leave the bag where it is. What was its condition?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った乾燥わかめの袋が、棚にしまうときに破れていると気づきました。まだ中身は食べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乾燥わかめの包装破れに気づき、未喫食であると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I noticed the dried wakame bag bought yesterday was torn when putting it on the shelf. I haven't eaten any yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain noticing torn dried-wakame packaging and not having eaten it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: レシートでは同じ商品が二点になっています。気づかれたのは、お持ちの一袋についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The receipt shows two of the same product. Did you notice the problem with the single bag you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、もう一袋は家で未開封のままです。二袋ともではなく、この一袋だけの相談です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入数二袋と不具合相談の一袋を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the other is still unopened at home. I'm consulting about this one bag, not both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the two bags bought from the one bag with the reported problem. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一袋の包装についてですね。破れたのがいつか分かる範囲と、購入後の保管状況を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: So it's one bag's packaging. Tell us what you know about when it tore and storage after purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰宅後は表示にある方法で保管しました。買う前から破れていたか、持ち帰る途中だったかまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示どおりの保管と、破れた時点が不明であることを分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: After returning home I stored it as labeled. I don't know whether it was torn before purchase or on the journey home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate storage according to the label from uncertainty about when the tear occurred. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からない時点はそのまま記録します。現物と購入記録を担当へ渡し、対応できる内容を確認します。ご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll record the unknown timing as unknown. We'll pass the item and purchase record to the staff and check possible responses. Do you have a preference?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 交換を希望しますが、今ここで決まったわけではないのですね。調べる間、この袋は担当の方に預けてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交換希望は未決定と確認し、調査のため袋を預ける相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like an exchange, but it hasn't been decided here yet, right? May I leave the bag with the staff while it is checked?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm exchange is only a request, not decided, and ask to leave the bag for inspection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、この一袋とレシートを担当へ渡します。交換ができるかは、その確認後のご案内になります。もう一袋を一緒に預かった扱いにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we'll give this one bag and receipt to the staff. Whether exchange is possible will be explained after checking. We won't treat the other bag as received too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相談するのは破れた一袋だけと伝わって安心しました。交換の可否が分かるまで、こちらで担当の方の案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 破れた一袋のみの相談と確認し、担当者からの返答を待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm relieved it's clear the query concerns only the torn bag. I'll wait here for the staff's guidance until exchange eligibility is known.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the query concerns only one torn bag and decide to await the staff's response. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一袋の商品相談としてお引き継ぎしました。担当がお声をかけますので、こちらの席へどうぞ。私からはこれで失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've passed it on as a one-bag product query. Staff will call you, so please take this seat. That is all from me; excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内の案内図はこちらです。どのようにお過ごしになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is the park map. How are you planning to spend your time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し歩いて、同じ入口へ戻りたいです。今日は長い距離を歩くつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長距離を避け同じ入口へ戻る散歩を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want a little walk and to return to the same entrance. I don't intend to walk far today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a walk avoiding long distances and returning to the same entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図では、入口から休憩所へ向かう道と、一周する道を分けてあります。休憩を挟むご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The map separates the path from the entrance to the rest area from the circuit. Do you want to rest along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 途中で座りたいです。一周の線に小さな階段の印がありますが、そこを通らない道を選べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 途中休憩と、案内図の階段を避ける経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to sit partway. The circuit has a small stair symbol; can I choose a route without it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about an intermediate rest and a route avoiding the map's stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。この案内図なら、階段のある周回ではなく、休憩所まで行って同じ道を戻る案にできます。到着までの時間は歩く速さによって変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. On this map, you can go to the rest area and back the same way instead of the stair circuit. Time depends on walking speed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 距離だけで時間を決めず、休憩所で戻るか考えます。図の休憩所の印は、入口から続くこの線の先ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 歩く時間は速さで変わると受け止め、休憩所の位置を図で確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't decide the time from distance alone; I'll consider turning back at the rest area. Its symbol is at the end of this line from the entrance, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge walking time varies with speed and check the rest area's position on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その線です。現在地の入口の印と、休憩所の印を一緒に確かめておけば、周回路へ進む案と混ざりにくくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That line is right. Checking both the current entrance and rest symbols makes it harder to confuse the return plan with the circuit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 戻るときは周回の矢印へ進まず、来た線を入口まで戻るのですね。入口の名前も手帳に書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 周回路ではなく来た道を入口へ戻ることを確認し入口名を控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Returning means following the line I came along, not the circuit arrows. I'll write the entrance's name in my notebook too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm returning to the entrance by the same path rather than the circuit and note the entrance name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 折返しの案が確認できました。図は道を選ぶためのものなので、歩く際はその場の路面や案内にも注意してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The return plan is clear. The map helps select paths; while walking, also watch the actual surface and signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず休憩所までの折返しにします。途中で疲れたらそこまで行くことにこだわらず、引き返して入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩所までの折返しを選び、途中で疲れた場合は早めに戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll start with going to the rest area and back. If tired partway, I won't insist on reaching it; I'll turn back to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the rest-area return walk and say you will turn back early if tired. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望の短い散歩として、折返し案をご案内しました。それでは、無理のない範囲でお楽しみください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've suggested the return route as your requested short walk. Enjoy it within your limits. Have a pleasant walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お出かけの日と、切符をお求めの区間を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me your travel date and the ticket section you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の展示会に行きます。このメモの会場最寄り駅まで、大人一人分を買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 翌日の展示会に行くため、メモの会場最寄り駅まで大人一人分の切符を求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm going to an exhibition tomorrow. I'd like one adult ticket to the station nearest the venue in this note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request one adult ticket to the noted station nearest the venue for tomorrow's exhibition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メモには往復の経路が載っていますね。お帰りも列車を利用なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The note has outward and return routes. Will you also take the train back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 帰りは知人の車に乗るかもしれないので、行きの片道だけにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰りは知人の車に乗る可能性を伝え、行きの片道だけを申し込む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I may return in an acquaintance's car, so please only the outward one-way ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention possibly returning in an acquaintance's car and request outward one-way only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 片道のみですね。ご利用日は今日ではなく、明日でお間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: One-way only. Please confirm the travel date is tomorrow, not today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗るのは明日です。今日買っても、利用日を明日に指定できるか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗車日は明日だと答え、今日購入して利用日を明日に指定できるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm traveling tomorrow. I'd like to check whether I can buy today and specify tomorrow as the use date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer tomorrow is the travel day and ask whether buying today can specify tomorrow's use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この窓口で扱える切符か、区間と利用日を調べます。券売機では何かお困りでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the section and date to see whether we handle that ticket. Did you have trouble at the machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 購入画面に今日の日付が出ていたので、支払わずに戻りました。こちらで続きをお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 券売機に今日の日付が出たため支払わず戻ったと説明し、窓口での対応を頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The purchase screen showed today's date, so I left without paying. Can you handle it here from there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain leaving the machine without paying because today's date appeared, and request counter assistance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 窓口では改めて内容を確認して、お申し込みを承ります。お支払いの控えもご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here, we'll confirm the details again and take a new application. Would you also like proof of payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 窓口で申し込み直します。明日利用の片道一枚で、支払いの控えもお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓口で申し込み直し、明日利用の片道一枚と支払いの控えを希望する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll apply again at the counter. One one-way for use tomorrow, and a payment receipt too, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Apply again at the counter for one one-way ticket used tomorrow and request proof of payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。区間と明日の日付をお見せしてから、お支払いへ進みます。帰りの分は含めません。お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll show the section and tomorrow's date before payment. No return trip is included. Have a safe outing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知のどの部分でお困りか、先にお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: First tell me which part of the notice is causing trouble.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所確認の通知に日付が二つあって、どちらまでに返事をするのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所確認の通知に日付が二つあり、回答すべき期限を読み分けられず困っていると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The address-verification notice has two dates, and I'm unsure which is the reply deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that two dates on an address-verification notice leave you unable to identify the response deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 用紙をこちらで拝見できますか。発行日と回答期限を分けて読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see the paper here? We'll distinguish issue date and reply deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここで見てください。封筒には別紙も入っていたはずですが、今日はこの一枚しかありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: その場で通知を見ることを認め、封筒の別紙が手元になく一枚だけ持参したと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Look here, please. There should have been an attachment in the envelope, but I only have this one sheet today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Allow the notice to be read there, and explain that you brought only one sheet without the envelope attachment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この欄は回答期限と書かれています。ただ、必要な添付書類は別紙を確認しないと分かりません。期限までに用意できそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This field says response deadline. But we can't know required attachments without the separate sheet. Do you think you can prepare them in time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書類の種類が分からないので、間に合うとは言えません。別紙をもう一度受け取る方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類の種類が不明で期限に間に合うか分からないと答え、別紙を再取得する方法を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't know which documents, so I can't say I'll make it. I'd like to know how to get the separate sheet again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the document types are unknown so meeting the deadline is uncertain, and ask how to obtain the attachment again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発行した担当へ、案内の再交付と不足している場合の相談を取り次ぎます。期限が変わるかは担当の回答が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll refer you to the issuing staff for another copy of the guidance and advice about missing items. A deadline change requires their answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 期限が延びたとは考えずに相談します。取り次ぐ際は、別紙がないことも伝えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限延長とは受け取らず相談すると述べ、取り次ぐ担当へ別紙の不足も伝えてほしいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't take this as an extension. When referring me, could you also mention the missing attachment?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you won't assume an extension and ask for the missing attachment to be mentioned to the staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その二点を伝えます。相談までの間、今持っている通知をお預かりしてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell them both. May I hold your current notice while you wait for the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知は手元に残したいです。担当の方に呼ばれたとき、私から直接お見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知を手元に残す希望を伝え、担当に呼ばれた際に自分から見せると申し出る。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to keep it with me. When the staff call, I'll show it directly myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request keeping the notice and offer to show it yourself when called. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、通知はお持ちのままで結構です。案内を受け直したい旨を担当へ伝えますので、こちらの相談席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then keep it with you. I'll tell the staff you want the guidance reissued; please wait in this consultation seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診ですね。今いちばん気になる症状を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: It's your first visit. Could you tell me the symptom worrying you most?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一週間ほど前から右のひざが痛みます。歩くときに気になりますが、こちらで診てもらうのは初めてです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初診であることと、一週間ほど続く右ひざの痛みが歩くときに気になることを伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My right knee has hurt for about a week. It bothers me when walking, and this is my first examination here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention your first visit and right-knee pain lasting about a week that bothers you while walking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 痛み始めたころに転んだり、ぶつけたりした覚えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember falling or hitting it around when the pain began?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はっきりしたけがの覚えはありません。いつ始まったか正確ではないので、そのまま問診票に書いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 明確なけがの覚えがなく発症時期も正確ではないと答え、その不確かさを問診票に書いてよいか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't recall a definite injury. I'm unsure exactly when it started; may I write that uncertainty on the questionnaire?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you recall no clear injury and the onset is uncertain, and ask whether to write the uncertainty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かる範囲と覚えていない点を分けて書いてください。普段お使いの薬の名前は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Separate what you know from what you don't remember. Do you know the names of medicines you regularly use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毎朝飲む薬がありますが、名前を覚えていません。手帳も家に置いてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 毎朝飲む薬があるが名称を覚えておらず、お薬手帳も持参していないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I take medicine every morning, but don't remember its name. I left my medication notebook at home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you take morning medicine but don't remember its name and haven't brought the notebook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 薬があることと、名称は未確認だということを診察する方へ伝えます。ご家族などに確かめられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the clinician there is medication but the name is unconfirmed. Can you check with family or someone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族に連絡して、薬の名前が読める写真を送ってもらいます。届くまでは不明と書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族に薬名の読める写真を頼み、確認できるまでは名称不明と記載すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask family to send a photo with the medicine name readable. Until it arrives, I'll write the name as unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a readable medicine-name photo from family and say you will record the name as unknown until confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真が届いたらお知らせください。書類の説明も続けますが、聞き取りづらいところはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell us when the photo arrives. I'll continue explaining documents too; is anything difficult to hear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 痛みについての質問を一度に言われると聞き取れません。次の説明は一つずつお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 痛みの質問をまとめて聞くと聞き取れないと説明し、以後は一つずつ説明してほしいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can't follow when questions about pain are all asked at once. Please explain the next things one at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain difficulty following pain questions together and request one-at-a-time explanations from now on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一項目ずつ伺いますね。症状が変わった場合は、待っている間でも職員へお声がけください。まずこちらのお席へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll ask one item at a time. If symptoms change, tell staff even while waiting. Please take this seat first.
